audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read "Irelia" while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — and the content whys are explicitly prefixed "Hwei favoured:" on the rows the full layer awarded to Irelia.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[] exactly, and 52.17% over 2423 games supports it. Kit basis: Bladesurge reaches 600 units and requires a target, so before she has Mark uptime she cannot close on a champion painting from range.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Hwei, phases[3..4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Hwei, with the four affected whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] promised the first item lets your combo "delete half her bar", and whys[5] said it "deletes her health bar" — magnitudes with no source. spikes[1] and `mid` both attributed "true damage and MR shred" to Vanguard's Edge.
audit.why: Riot's text for Vanguard's Edge describes damage, a Mark, and a wall of blades that damages and slows — no true damage and no magic-resistance shred. The real level-6 story is a 950-unit line on a 125-second cooldown that leaves terrain behind you.
audit.corrected: Magnitudes removed; the ult is described by its actual range, cooldown, Mark and wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer used three Hwei ability names that do not exist — "Severalty (Q)" for a wall, "Devastating Fire Painting (E)" for a stun, and "Fractured Facade (W)" for walls — and built the whole gameplan on a wall Hwei does not have. The full layer used "EE fear", "EQ root" and "WW speed paths". Nothing anywhere mentioned that Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only.
audit.why: Hwei's Q sub-abilities are Devastating Fire / Severing Bolt / Molten Fissure (QQ/QW/QE) — Devastating Fire is damage, not a stun, and none of them is a wall. His E sub-abilities are Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE) and his W paints are Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights — the speed paint is Fleeting Current on WQ. Riot's Defiant Dance text: "She takes reduced physical damage during the charge." Hwei deals magic damage, so her charge blunts nothing he does. Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes on a Marked target, and Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge are what apply the Mark — that chain is the matchup.
audit.corrected: Real names throughout; the decisive line is now stated: being Marked is what refunds Bladesurge, so eating a Flawless Duet with Grim Visage spent turns one dash into a chain. Added that your paint goes through Defiant Dance untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appeared only in one misgendered report line despite Bladesurge healing on every reset.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: "Irelia sustains through chip damage (Bladesurge (Q)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades."
audit.corrected: Anti-heal now appears in loading, breakdown.feeding and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: 21 lint hits: Irelia called "he/his/him" across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, two phases whys, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, three dos/donts fields and seven report entries. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields regendered; non-report fields rewritten with kit-grounded content, report entries pronoun-swapped only.

notes: Chart: all seven full-layer sides read "Irelia" while the content whys are literally prefixed "Hwei favoured:" on four of those rows — the page argued with itself in the most visible way possible. Sides now match content and packet.levelChart; win[] needed no edit. Ratings left at 8/8/8/8/7/7/7. Three fabricated Hwei ability names were driving the content layer's whole gameplan: "Severalty (Q)" and "Fractured Facade (W)" as walls and "Devastating Fire Painting (E)" as a stun. Hwei has no wall in his kit at all, so "wall off her approach" and "teamfights where your walls control her engine" were advice for a champion that does not exist; I replaced them with Grim Visage (EQ) placement. Two real finds worth the user's attention: (1) Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so Irelia's charge does nothing against Hwei's magic damage — that was absent from the page and is now in dosFull[2].d; (2) Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes on a MARKED target, and Flawless Duet and Vanguard's Edge are what apply the Mark, so the cost of eating the stun is a dash chain rather than one dash. I removed the claim that Vanguard's Edge deals true damage and shreds MR — packet.suspectNames flagged that sentence, and neither effect appears in Riot's text. Flagging it as unverified rather than asserting the opposite. Report entries were pronoun-swapped only, per the sweep exclusion.
